mapper.sql: id, tenant_id, request_id, client_id, client_code, capability_id, capability_code, capability_version, actor_type, actor_user_id, service_user_id, active_org_id, result_status, result_code, error_code, failure_stage, error_message, schema_path, trace_id, duration_ms, del_flag, create_by, create_time, create_dept, update_by, update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_capability_invocation_log ( id, tenant_id, request_id, client_id, client_code, capability_id, capability_code, capability_version, actor_type, actor_user_id, service_user_id, active_org_id, result_status, result_code, error_code, failure_stage, error_message, schema_path, trace_id, duration_ms, del_flag, create_by, create_time, create_dept, update_by, update_time ) VALUES ( #{log.id}, #{log.tenantId}, #{log.requestId}, #{log.clientId}, #{log.clientCode}, #{log.capabilityId}, #{log.capabilityCode}, #{log.capabilityVersion}, #{log.actorType}, #{log.actorUserId}, #{log.serviceUserId}, #{log.activeOrgId}, #{log.resultStatus}, #{log.resultCode}, #{log.errorCode}, #{log.failureStage}, #{log.errorMessage}, #{log.schemaPath}, #{log.traceId}, #{log.durationMs}, 0, #{log.createBy}, COALESCE(#{log.createTime}, NOW()), #{log.createDept}, #{log.updateBy}, COALESCE(#{log.updateTime}, NOW()) )
mapper.sql: log.id, log.request_id, log.client_id, log.client_code, log.capability_id, capability.capability_name, log.capability_code, log.capability_version, log.actor_type, log.actor_user_id, actor.username AS actor_username, actor.real_name AS actor_real_name, log.service_user_id, service_user.username AS service_username, service_user.real_name AS service_real_name, log.active_org_id, log.result_status, log.result_code, log.error_code, log.failure_stage, log.error_message, log.schema_path, log.trace_id, log.duration_ms, log.create_time, log.update_time

FROM ai_capability_invocation_log log LEFT JOIN ai_capability capability ON capability.tenant_id = log.tenant_id AND capability.id = log.capability_id LEFT JOIN sys_user actor ON actor.tenant_id = log.tenant_id AND actor.id = log.actor_user_id LEFT JOIN sys_user service_user ON service_user.tenant_id = log.tenant_id AND service_user.id = log.service_user_id
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ai_capability_invocation_log WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND request_id = #{requestId} AND del_flag = 0 LIMIT 1
